batch.topic: A survey permits multiple choices and reports percentages that need not sum to100; preserve denominator and scope without inventing results.
A simulation terminates when either of two stopping conditions is met; do not change either into both.
A mathematical statement distinguishes at most one solution from exactly one solution; absence of a solution is allowed by the first statement.
A program distinguishes a file that does not exist from an existing file of zero bytes; do not equate both with a read failure.
